title: Total Destruction Redux: F4 Phantom vs. Concrete Wall - Additional Camera Angles
summary: Additional camera angles of the 1988 Sandia National Laboratories rocket-sled test in which an F-4 Phantom was crashed at about 500 mph into a block of reinforced concrete. The footage shows the aircraft disintegrating against the wall.
why: HN commenters cite it in nuclear and engineering debates as evidence that concrete containment structures can withstand aircraft impacts.

quote.text: You may have seen the famous test of ramming a F4 Phantom into a reinforced concrete walls without much effect
